text:
Fixed the bug in `middleware/proxy.go`.

Root cause: with an empty target list, `randomBalancer.Next` called `rand.Intn(0)` (panic) and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` did `b.i % 0` (integer divide-by-zero panic), and `ProxyWithConfig` dereferenced the returned target unconditionally.

Changes (only `middleware/proxy.go`):
- `randomBalancer.Next` now returns `nil` when there are no targets.
- `roundRobinBalancer.Next` now returns `nil` when there are no targets (also takes the read lock for consistency with the other balancer).
- `ProxyWithConfig` now checks for a `nil` target and returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (503) instead of panicking.

Verified: `go test ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass (all pre-existing tests green, including `TestProxy`, `TestProxy_1_11`, `TestClientCancelConnectionResultsHTTPCode499`), and an ad-hoc check confirmed both balancers return `nil` with no targets and the middleware responds 503 rather than panicking.

#1 is fixed and verified: `middleware/proxy.go` balancers now return `nil` when there are no targets and `ProxyWithConfig` returns 503 (`echo.ErrServiceUnavailable`) instead of panicking. Full test suite (incl. -race) passes.
#2 (router.go / TestRouterNoRoutablePath) is still in progress — I've reproduced the router's behavior with fuzzing and am narrowing down the exact defect. ETA ~12 minutes.
#1 fixed and verified (proxy.go: nil-safe balancers + 503 on nil target; full suite green).

#4 done: `context.go` `Scheme()` now ignores invalid values in `X-Forwarded-Proto`, `X-Forwarded-Protocol` and `X-Url-Scheme` (only `http`/`https` accepted) and falls back to `http`; `X-Forwarded-Ssl: on` still yields `https`. Full suite green.
#5 done: `bind.go` `bindData` map branch now skips nil values, so binding to `map[string][]string` (e.g. `url.Values`) no longer panics. Full suite green.

#8 done: `middleware/compress.go` `gzipResponseWriter.Write` now ignores empty payloads, so an empty response body is no longer turned into a 10-byte gzip header (Content-Encoding is dropped and the body stays empty). Full suite green.
#2 (router.go / TestRouterNoRoutablePath) still open — narrowing it down now, ETA ~3 min.
#7 (group.go / TestMultipleGroupSamePathMiddleware) still open — narrowing it down now, ETA ~3 min.

Status: #2 (router.go / TestRouterNoRoutablePath) is NOT fixed yet — I could not pin down the exact defect in time (fuzzing of Find/Add with empty and non-routable paths showed no panic, hang or wrong result, and the empty-router case already returns ErrNotFound). No unverified change was made, so the repo stays green.

Status: #7 (group.go / TestMultipleGroupSamePathMiddleware) is NOT fixed yet — group middleware inheritance, per-group middleware isolation and nested groups all behaved correctly in my probes, so I could not identify the defect in time. No unverified change was made, so the repo stays green.
